[Image: A numbered axis from 26 to 28. There are four marks in between 26 to 27, as well as in between 27 to 28. K is marked underneath the last mark between 27 and 28.]

Which number does K represent on this number line?
figure_description: A horizontal number line with arrowheads at both ends. There are evenly spaced vertical tick marks. The first labeled tick mark is labeled 26 below the line. Between 26 and 27, there are 4 evenly spaced tick marks dividing the interval into 5 equal parts. The tick mark for 27 is labeled below the line. Between 27 and 28, there are 4 evenly spaced tick marks, with the fourth tick mark labeled with the letter K below the line. The next tick mark is labeled 28 below the line. The line extends slightly past 26 to the left and past 28 to the right.
